propositions: Create canonical `rebar bridge status` read-only command and hidden `bridge-status` compatibility alias that expose identical durable last-pass state, verdict, and exit codes over a single authoritative `refs/reconciler/last-pass` ref.

Consolidate two overlapping pass-record producers into one writer that records minimal JSON (schema version, pass id, environment id, outcome, failure kind, timestamp, lock fence) via CAS with three bounded retries and loud persistent-push failure, advancing the ref before releasing the lock.

Implement exact verdict precedence (PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY, NEVER_RUN when no record/lock) with corresponding exit codes; omitted --max-age disables age failure and paused remains exit 0 even when old.

Derive environment identity explicitly from REBAR_ENV_ID or stable `local:<repo-env-id>` from checkout .env-id, never implicitly selecting `reconciler`, and reject missing/empty/.env-id as hard configuration error while preserving inbound event metadata and legacy Jira inference unchanged.

Implement canary two-snapshot crash detection using observed-OID and stalled fence across the lock-blob-carried lease_secs, rejecting observed leases over 480s, and stage rollout behind explicit REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api until producer has written last-pass once.

Store one fixed rolling rich-detail file `.tickets-tracker/.bridge_state/last-pass.json`, safely degrade when missing or mismatched, and remove duplicate producers plus dead baseline/fsck symbols after updating all callers, proven by semantic and string-reference sweeps.
